## Progress

- [PR #80](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/80) (in review): `POST /v1/appointments/{id}/reschedule|cancel|no-show` on the booking path (doctor-day locks, template and hold re-checks, old slot freed and new one taken in one transaction), audited by use case; reschedule history table (old slot, new slot, actor, time) and outbox events with opaque ids only; cancel reason list + note (Other needs one, note SensitiveHealth); no-show only from Booked after the start; cancel from Booked or Checked in (narrower than the design, recorded in state-machines.md); appointment panel with each action allowed or disabled with its reason, reschedule by click or drag always confirmed, same-kind calendars only, no-show offers rebook with the patient filled in; en/hi/ar, RTL
- Tested on SQL Server (12 tests incl. 100-way reschedule race, reschedule vs hold race, lock waits on both days) and in the browser against a real API (two desks, drag, cancel, check-in, ar, axe); 23 mutations each caught
- Left: patient notification of reschedule/cancel (MDV-P1-032, outbox events written); the no-show metric itself (MDV-P1-041, reads the NoShow events); reschedule history shown in the panel

## Description

Detail panel actions with state rules: Check in (only Booked), Reschedule (not Completed), Cancel (asks reason; not Completed/Cancelled), Mark no-show (only Booked). Drag-and-drop reschedule asks for confirmation and uses the same booking concurrency path. No-show offers "Rebook" which opens booking with the patient preselected. Reschedule/cancel notify the patient (MDV-P1-032).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Disallowed actions are disabled with an explanation and rejected by the API if called.
- [ ] **AC2.** Cancel without a reason is impossible; reasons are a short list + free text.
- [ ] **AC3.** A reschedule keeps history (old slot, new slot, actor, time) and frees the old slot atomically.
- [ ] **AC4.** No-show offers rebook and is counted in the no-show metric (MDV-P1-041).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
